idea: A mobile app that helps college students organize study sessions and track assignment deadlines.
A simple AI habit coach that reminds users to drink water, stretch, and sleep on time.
A flashcard generator that turns lecture notes into practice questions for high school students.
An AI customer support copilot for small ecommerce brands that drafts replies, tags tickets, and detects refund-risk cases.
An AI contract review assistant for small legal teams that flags risky clauses and summarizes obligations.
A scheduling optimization platform that reduces patient no-shows for outpatient clinics using reminders and risk scoring.
A HIPAA-aware multi-agent platform that coordinates insurance pre-authorization, patient scheduling, and clinical documentation for specialty clinics.

A cross-border supply-chain risk platform that predicts shipment delays using vendor data, weather, customs rules, and geopolitical signals.
